subject: general
question: Four number-triads have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the number-triad that is different from the rest.
solution:
The logic followed here is :

__
 
• **(sum of two digits of the second number)²**(Sum of two digits of the first number)2** = Third number**

**​Note: **Two square terms are not multiplied, they are placed next to each other.__

**(1): ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/033f32470d4ea49dbd873b4d25731d786f068f909d27720807bb64f4f2420973.png] 

**(2):** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b660d5e3dcf8e47d573d9b54788f738d376eb4466c1ea4b12c3e7676f346a0f5.png] 

**(3):** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bbe5a8098e87c801aef5d879aa9aa8d1a407da0484e60150e90f4718f3ce36bf.png] 

**(4):** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/67a95649000d82ff548bf598337d29f2742f7f6619a8b28829cbeb0baf760f5e.png] 

As all options follow the logic except option (2). 

Hence, the correct answer is **17,18,6481**.
